description: This file defines a Fragment class 'RecipeDetailFragment' for an Android application. It displays detailed information about a recipe, including an image, title, meta info, ingredients, and steps. It interacts with mock data to populate the UI and manages view initialization and user interactions like the back button.

classes.name: RecipeDetailFragment
classes.description: A Fragment displaying detailed information about a recipe, including image, title, ingredients, and steps. It fetches data using a mock data provider and handles UI setup and user interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, retrieves the recipe ID from arguments, and fetches the recipe data.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout for the fragment.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Populates the UI elements with recipe data, sets up images, text views, ingredient and step lists, and handles back button behavior.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance of the fragment with provided recipe ID.
